# HugScarf

> HugScarf is a travel pillow and a scarf in one piece: a memory-foam neck core with modular plush character arms that wrap around the shoulders like a hug.

HugScarf is a project by Michael Novoselov.
Copyright © Michael Novoselov.

Canonical website: https://hugscarf.co/

## Product
- Travel pillow and scarf in one piece, designed for long-haul flights and everyday rest.
- Memory-foam core supports the neck; soft plush character arms wrap around the shoulders.
- Modular: character arms are interchangeable, so the look can change with mood, outfit or destination.
- Designed to be worn openly, as a fashion accessory in the terminal and a pillow in the seat.
- Visual style: crocheted and knitted textures, bright pastel colours, playful characters.

## Status
- In development and preparing for launch. HugScarf is not available for purchase yet and the website does not take orders.
- Final materials, pricing and availability have not been announced.
- Personalization is planned for the second release: choosing from the HugScarf character collection or creating a custom character from an uploaded image. Uploaded images must be the customer's own or used with rights.

## Links
- [Home and project updates](https://hugscarf.co/): project overview, email subscription, FAQ.
- [Brand and creative collaborations](https://hugscarf.co/#partners-title): the project is open to collaborations around licensed character designs and travel accessories.
